description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents “At Ease” in Seacrest Beach! Located right on the Lagoon Pool, this spacious retreat features 5 luxurious suites, a private poolside patio, and a stunning 3rd-floor balcony with a wet bar, porch swings and grill. Explore 30A with 7 cruiser bikes and enjoy easy access to pristine beaches, dining, and shopping. Ideal for families or groups seeking a serene getaway on 30A, where relaxation comes At Ease! Learn more below…*** HIGHLIGHTS *** Direct Lagoon Pool Access: Step out from your patio into the 12,000 sq. ft. tropical pool paradise. Prime Location in Seacrest Community: 2-Min Walk to Boutique Shops, Dining at Peddlers Pavilion. Luxe Outdoor Living: Enjoy a 3rd-floor balcony with a TV, grill, wet bar, dining area, and custom porch swings. Spacious Accommodations for 14: Includes 4 King Suites with En-suites and a fun bunk room for kids. Seasonal Tram Service to the Beach: Take the tram for convenient seasonal beach access, which is just a 7-minute walk away. 7 Bikes Included with Your Stay: Explore the scenic 30A area with adult beach bikes. Rosemary & Alys Proximity: Within a short distance to the iconic neighboring communities and their stunning beaches.Eager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Guests: "Our stay was fantastic! Plenty of space, a well-stocked kitchen, and the Lagoon Pool was amazing!" – Toni H. "This home had everything we needed and more. Loved the location near the pool and beach!" – TA R.*** LIVING AREAS ***The living areas at “At Ease” combine style and comfort with coastal-inspired décor and an open-plan layout for easy gatherings. The ground-floor living area offers direct access to the Lagoon Pool, making it the ultimate space for relaxation and fun. Open-concept living area with cozy seating and coastal décor. Large flat-screen TV for family movie nights. Direct Lagoon Pool access from the back patio.*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***Cooking and dining are a breeze in this fully equipped chef’s kitchen, designed for both functionality and style. Whether you're preparing a gourmet feast or hosting a casual gathering, this entertainer's paradise has everything you need. Ample counter space, premium appliances, and a spacious dining area make it perfect for meals and memories. Fully stocked kitchen with stainless steel appliances. Bar seating for 4 and a dining table for 6. Outdoor dining options on the 1st floor patio and 3rd-floor balcony.*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***Dive into the Lagoon Pool or enjoy the views from the spacious 3rd-floor balcony. Whether you're grilling a delicious meal or unwinding after a swim, these spaces are perfect for soaking up the Florida sunshine and creating unforgettable memories.1st Floor Patio Private poolside patio with grill Seating and dining area for morning coffee or evening cocktails Easy access to the Lagoon Pool3rd-Floor Balcony Gorgeous pool views from the 3rd-floor balcony Dining table and grilling area Wet bar for cocktails and refreshments Comfortable custom porch swing Outdoor furniture and entertainment with a Smart TV*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***1st Floor: King Guest Suite: King bed with plush furnishings, an En-suite bathroom, and a smart TV. Half Bathroom: Located in the hallway for convenience.2nd Floor: Primary Suite: King bed, private balcony overlooking the Lagoon Pool, an En-suite with dual sinks, a soaking tub, a walk-in shower, and a smart TV. King Guest Suite (Left): King bed with a private En-suite and a smart TV. King Guest Suite (Right): King bed with a private En-suite and a smart TV. Laundry Room: Dual washers and dryers for guest convenience.3rd Floor: Bunk Room: 2 lofted Twin beds and 2 Twin-over-Twin bunks, sleeping up to 6 guests, with a smart TV, XL bean bags and plenty of play room. Bunk Room Bathroom: Features dual sinks and a walk-in shower.*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY AMENITIES ***Nestled in the vibrant Seacrest Beach community between Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach, "At Ease" is a charming retreat that perfectly blends relaxation and convenience. With included bikes, exploring nearby attractions is a breeze. Lagoon Pool – A 12,000 sq. ft. paradise Directly Out the Back Door, featuring a zero-entry splash zone, waterfalls, and plenty of loungers. Beach Access – Seasonal tram service makes getting to the beach easy, perfect for carrying your gear. Peddler’s Pavilion – A quick 2-minute walk to boutique shops, live music, dining, and seasonal nightlife. Rosemary Beach – Only a 10-minute walk to this scenic coastal destination. Alys Beach – Just a 9-minute walk for picturesque views and charming experiences. Scenic Walking & Nature Trails – Explore beautiful trails just steps away. Bike-Friendly Community – Enjoy the included bikes for easy access to nearby spots. Outdoor Amenities – Relax with outdoor seating, loungers, picnic tables, and a grill station. South Walton’s Tallest Sand Dunes – A unique natural feature of this stunning area.*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW *** Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independently. We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment. This property has 7 bikes for guest use. To utilize the bikes, a waiver must be signed before the code is provided to the guest. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes. There is an active Ring doorbell camera at the entrance door of the home. LSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 104430STRO #: STR-104430
